BASEBALL BAT.description: A bat used for playing baseball, which just so happens to be useful for bonking people over the head. Fast swing time with very long range and lower damage.
BASEBALL BAT.name: BASEBALL BAT

HOCKEY STICK.description: The perfect tool to end the game of those that get in your way, but then apologize straight after. Fast swing.
HOCKEY STICK.name: HOCKEY STICK

SLEDGE HAMMER.description: A heavy, industrial grade sledge hammer. Very high damage and long range with slow swing speed.
SLEDGE HAMMER.name: SLEDGE HAMMER

SCL-S3: DRASTIC.description:
Melee for the winners of the third season of the StyLiS Competitive League.
Bearing a comically oversized kitchen utensil, bludgen your enemies with only a spoonful of pain! Congratulations to Drastic!
Model by Boxie.
SCL-S3: DRASTIC.name: SCL-S3: DRASTIC

ZIRCON SLAMSICKLE.description: A truly retro hammer and scythe combo crafted from jewels. The perfect tool for multiple situations. Halloween 2020 Melee.
ZIRCON SLAMSICKLE.name: ZIRCON SLAMSICKLE

SCL-S4: MALICIOUS INTENT.description:
Melee for the winners of the fourth season of the StyLiS Competitive League.
TBE.
SCL-S4: MALICIOUS INTENT.name: SCL-S4: MALICIOUS INTENT

STYLIS BRUSH.description: Brush often, floss, and beat them to an inch of their life.
STYLIS BRUSH.name: STYLIS BRUSH

STOPPER.description:
You'd have to be a crazed clown to use a stop sign as a melee weapon!
The most nimble of the 'heavy weight' weapons.
Model by Vic.
Spotting Easter Egg voiced by Zesty.
STOPPER.name: STOPPER

SCL-S1: GANG.description:
Trophy for winners of the first ever season of the StyLiS Competitive League.
Bludgeon your foes, or strike them down with the souls of your defeated enemies!
Congratulations to GANG!
SCL-S1: GANG.name: SCL-S1: GANG

BAN HAMMER.description:
A comically large gavel commemorating your time and work on staff.
From all of us at StyLiS Studios, thank you staff members for all that you do!
Model by Duo.
BAN HAMMER.name: BAN HAMMER

CURSED SHINAI.description: A large training sword primaly made of bamboo. It's cursed to house a foul Yokai that downed many foes with this very training sword. Stare at the sword long enough, and you will hear them...
CURSED SHINAI.name: CURSED SHINAI

BANJO.description:
If it hadn't been for Cotton-Eye Joe, I'd been married a long time ago.

Where did you come from, where did you go? Where did you come from, Cotton-Eye Joe?
BANJO.name: BANJO

WARHAMMER.description:
Forged by the blacksmiths of the middle east, this warhammer has been through countless battles. Treat it right, and it'll treat you right.
Holiday 2020 melee made by ILLAXIS.
WARHAMMER.name: WARHAMMER

MORNING STAR.description: The classic pointy star of war found throughout history now in the palms of your hands. Use your power without remorse, the crusade starts again!
MORNING STAR.name: MORNING STAR

VOID STAFF.description:
Void worm inspired melee, weaponize the power of a black hole into this inhuman staff. Conjure a strike of pure void lightning which comes with great range, but even greater charge-up time.
Halloween 2020 Melee.
VOID STAFF.name: VOID STAFF

CRANE.description: A special reward for a limited-time-only event. A gigantic toy replica of the Crane. Campers sold separately.
CRANE.name: CRANE

KANABO.description:
Translated to mean ''Metal Stick''.
A studded two hand war club recreation made from heavy wood and iron. It is the weapon of choice for ogres!
KANABO.name: KANABO

PADDLE.description:
A perfect weapon for paddling the competition into unsafe waters. Wouldn't recommend using it for actual boating.
Model by Shelby.
PADDLE.name: PADDLE

SWEEPER.description:
The warzone gets pretty dirty, and it looks like you were hired to clean it.
Model by ILLAXIS.
SWEEPER.name: SWEEPER

CLEMENTINE.description:
Deep from the jungles of a two-dimensional land does this instrument of interior decoration and woodcutting come from. Good speed, good damage.
By Makosushi.
Halloween 2020 Melee.
CLEMENTINE.name: CLEMENTINE
